scenarios.description: Two authorized sibling workers complete ordinary tasks.
Four 40-unit requests alternate between sibling grants under one 100-unit root.
A leaf attempts one delegation beyond the root depth limit.
A child credential claims to outlive its ancestor, whose lease expires at tick 4.
A queued action reaches execution after its ancestor is revoked.
An authorized task needs input obtainable only through a responsive review service.
A false complaint temporarily freezes valid work; unrelated auxiliary work can continue.
A relay suppresses a minority hazard report; direct intake bypasses the relay in the review arm.
